    @conv_prefix "tiffytime:conv:"

    @user_research_prefix "tiffytime:user_research:"

    def save_conversation(conv_id, conv_data) do
      case get_client() do
        nil -> false
        client ->
          try do
            key = @conv_prefix <> conv_id
            Redix.command(client, ["SETEX", key, @ttl_seconds, Jason.encode!(conv_data)])
            user_id = conv_data["user_id"]
            if user_id do
              user_key = @user_convs_prefix <> user_id
              Redix.command(client, ["SADD", user_key, conv_id])
              Redix.command(client, ["EXPIRE", user_key, @ttl_seconds])
            end
            true
          rescue
            e ->
              Logger.error("Dragonfly save_conversation error: #{inspect(e)}")
              false
          end
      end
    end

    def get_conversation(conv_id) do
      case get_client() do
        nil -> nil
        client ->
          try do
            key = @conv_prefix <> conv_id
            case Redix.command(client, ["GET", key]) do
              {:ok, nil} -> nil
              {:ok, data} -> Jason.decode!(data)
              _ -> nil
            end
          rescue
            e ->
              Logger.error("Dragonfly get_conversation error: #{inspect(e)}")
              nil
          end
      end
    end

    def delete_conversation(conv_id, user_id) do
      case get_client() do
        nil -> false
        client ->
          try do
            key = @conv_prefix <> conv_id
            Redix.command(client, ["DEL", key])
            user_key = @user_convs_prefix <> user_id
            Redix.command(client, ["SREM", user_key, conv_id])
            true
          rescue
            e ->
              Logger.error("Dragonfly delete_conversation error: #{inspect(e)}")
              false
          end
      end
    end

    def get_user_conversations(user_id) do
      case get_client() do
        nil -> []
        client ->
          try do
            user_key = @user_convs_prefix <> user_id
            {:ok, conv_ids} = Redix.command(client, ["SMEMBERS", user_key])
            Enum.map(conv_ids || [], fn conv_id ->
              get_conversation(conv_id)
            end)

          rescue

              []

  defmodule SuperMemoryClient do
    @base_url ""
    @max_retries 3
    @default_timeout 30000

    def is_available do
      Config.supermemory_api_key() != ""
    end

    def add_memory(content, metadata \\ nil, container_tags \\ nil, custom_id \\ nil) do
      unless is_available(), do: {:error, "API key missing"}

      payload = %{content: content}
      payload = if metadata, do: Map.put(payload, :metadata, metadata), else: payload
      payload = if container_tags, do: Map.put(payload, :containerTags, container_tags), else: payload
      payload = if custom_id, do: Map.put(payload, :customId, custom_id), else: payload

      case request_with_retry(:post, "#{@base_url}/v3/documents", payload) do
        {:ok, %{status_code: code, body: body}} when code in [200, 201] ->
          result = Jason.decode!(body)
          Logger.info("SuperMemory document added: #{Map.get(result, "id", "unknown")}")
          {:ok, result}
        {:ok, %{status_code: code, body: body}} ->
          Logger.warning("SuperMemory add failed: #{code} - #{String.slice(body, 0, 200)}")
          {:error, "Failed"}
        {:error, reason} ->
          Logger.error("SuperMemory add error: #{inspect(reason)}")
          {:error, reason}
      end
    end

    def search_memories(query, limit \\ 10, container_tags \\ nil, rerank \\ true) do
      unless is_available(), do: []

      payload = %{q: query, limit: min(limit, 50), rerank: rerank}
      payload = if container_tags, do: Map.put(payload, :containerTags, container_tags), else: payload

      case request_with_retry(:post, "#{@base_url}/v3/search", payload) do
        {:ok, %{status_code: 200, body: body}} ->
          result = Jason.decode!(body)
          memories = Map.get(result, "results", [])
          Logger.info("SuperMemory search found #{length(memories)} results for: #{String.slice(query, 0, 50)}")
          memories
        {:ok, %{status_code: code}} ->
          Logger.warning("SuperMemory search failed: #{code}")
          []
        {:error, _} ->
          []
      end
    end

    def delete_memory(document_id) do
      unless is_available(), do: false

      case request_with_retry(:delete, "#{@base_url}/v3/documents/#{document_id}", nil) do
        {:ok, %{status_code: code}} when code in [200, 204] ->
          Logger.info("SuperMemory document deleted: #{document_id}")
          true
        {:ok, %{status_code: code}} ->
          Logger.warning("SuperMemory delete failed: #{code}")
          false
        {:error, _} ->
          false
      end
    end

    def add_chat_memory(user_id, conversation_id, user_message, assistant_response) do
      content = "Felhasználó kérdése: #{user_message}\nAI válasz: #{assistant_response}"
      metadata = %{

      end
    end

      content = "Kutatási téma: #{goal}\nÖsszefoglaló: #{summary}\nFeldolgozott források száma: #{sources_count}"
      metadata = %{

        user_id: user_id,

        timestamp: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601()
      }

      case add_memory(content, metadata, ["research", "user_#{user_id}"], "research_#{session_id}") do
        {:ok, result} -> Map.get(result, "id")
        _ -> nil
      end
    end

    def get_relevant_context(user_id, query, max_results \\ 5) do
      memories = search_memories(query, max_results, ["user_#{user_id}"], true)

      if Enum.empty?(memories) do
        ""
      else
        context_parts = ["=== KORÁBBI RELEVÁNS INFORMÁCIÓK ==="]

        indexed_parts = memories
        |> Enum.take(max_results)
        |> Enum.with_index(1)
        |> Enum.map(fn {mem, i} ->
          chunks = Map.get(mem, "chunks", [])
          relevant_text = if Enum.any?(chunks) do
            chunks |> List.first() |> Map.get("content", "") |> String.slice(0, 500)
          else
            Map.get(mem, "content", "") |> String.slice(0, 500)
          end

          if relevant_text != "", do: "\n[#{i}] #{relevant_text}", else: nil
        end)
        |> Enum.reject(&is_nil/1)

        Enum.join(context_parts ++ indexed_parts ++ ["\n=== KONTEXTUS VÉGE ===\n"], "\n")
      end
    end

    defp request_with_retry(method, url, payload, attempt \\ 0) do
      if attempt >= @max_retries, do: {:error, "Max retries exceeded"}

      headers = [
        {"Authorization", "Bearer #{Config.supermemory_api_key()}"},
        {"Content-Type", "application/json"}
      ]

      response = case method do
        :post -> HTTPoison.post(url, Jason.encode!(payload), headers, recv_timeout: @default_timeout)
        :delete -> HTTPoison.delete(url, headers, recv_timeout: @default_timeout)
        :get -> HTTPoison.get(url, headers, recv_timeout: @default_timeout)
        _ -> HTTPoison.request(method, url, Jason.encode!(payload || ""), headers, recv_timeout: @default_timeout)
      end

      case response do
        {:ok, %{status_code: code}} when code == 429 or code >= 500 ->
          wait_time = :math.pow(2, attempt) * 2 |> round()
          Logger.warning("SuperMemory API #{code}, retrying in #{wait_time}s (attempt #{attempt + 1}/#{@max_retries})")
          Process.sleep(wait_time * 1000)
          request_with_retry(method, url, payload, attempt + 1)
        {:ok, resp} -> {:ok, resp}
        {:error, %HTTPoison.Error{reason: :timeout}} ->
          wait_time = :math.pow(2, attempt) * 2 |> round()
          Logger.warning("SuperMemory timeout, retrying in #{wait_time}s (attempt #{attempt + 1}/#{@max_retries})")
          if attempt < @max_retries - 1 do
            Process.sleep(wait_time * 1000)
            request_with_retry(method, url, payload, attempt + 1)
          else
            {:error, :timeout}
          end
        {:error, reason} ->
          Logger.error("SuperMemory request error: #{inspect(reason)}")
          if attempt < @max_retries - 1 do
            Process.sleep(:math.pow(2, attempt) * 2 |> round() * 1000)
            request_with_retry(method, url, payload, attempt + 1)
          else
            {:error, reason}
          end
      end
    end
  end

        {"Content-Type", "application/json"}
      ]

      payload = %{
        model: "grok-4-1-fast",
        messages: [
          %{role: "system", content: system_prompt},
          %{role: "user", content: user_message}
        ],
        max_tokens: max_tokens,
        temperature: max(0.0, min(2.0, temperature)),
        stream: include_reasoning
      }

      payload = if include_reasoning, do: Map.put(payload, :reasoning, %{effort: "high"}), else: payload

      start_time = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)

      case HTTPoison.post("", Jason.encode!(payload), headers, recv_timeout: @default_timeout, stream_to: self()) do
        {:ok, %{status_code: 429}} ->
          wait_time = :math.pow(2, attempt) * 2 |> round()
          Logger.warning("Tiffy API rate limited (429), retrying in #{wait_time}s (attempt #{attempt + 1}/#{@max_retries})")
          Process.sleep(wait_time * 1000)
          call_tiffy_api(system_prompt, user_message, max_tokens, temperature, include_reasoning, session_id, attempt + 1)

        {:ok, %{status_code: 200, body: body}} when not include_reasoning ->
          processing_time = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - start_time
          result = Jason.decode!(body)
          content = get_in(result, ["choices", Access.at(0), "message", "content"])
          tokens_used = get_in(result, ["usage", "total_tokens"]) || 0
          %{content: content, tokens_used: tokens_used, processing_time: processing_time}

        {:ok, %{status_code: code}} ->
          Logger.error("Tiffy API error: #{code}")
          raise "Tiffy API returned #{code}"

        {:error, %HTTPoison.Error{reason: :timeout}} ->
          Logger.error("Tiffy API timeout")
          if attempt < @max_retries - 1 do
            Process.sleep(:math.pow(2, attempt) * 2 |> round() * 1000)
            call_tiffy_api(system_prompt, user_message, max_tokens, temperature, include_reasoning, session_id, attempt + 1)
          else
            raise "API timeout"
          end

        {:error, reason} ->
          Logger.error("Tiffy API error: #{inspect(reason)}")
          if String.contains?(to_string(reason), "429") and attempt < @max_retries - 1 do
            Process.sleep(:math.pow(2, attempt) * 2 |> round() * 1000)
            call_tiffy_api(system_prompt, user_message, max_tokens, temperature, include_reasoning, session_id, attempt + 1)
          else
            raise reason
          end
      end
    end

    def call_tiffy_search(query, num_results \\ 100, search_type \\ "auto", use_deep \\ false, attempt \\ 0) do
      if attempt >= @max_retries, do: []

      api_key = Config.exa_api_key()
      if api_key == "", do: []

      headers = [
        {"x-api-key", api_key},
        {"Content-Type", "application/json"}
      ]

      actual_type = if use_deep, do: "deep", else: search_type

      payload = %{
        query: query,
        numResults: num_results,
        type: actual_type,
        text: true,
        livecrawl: "always",
        highlights: %{numSentences: 10, highlightsPerUrl: 5}
      }

      case HTTPoison.post("", Jason.encode!(payload), headers, recv_timeout: 60_000) do
        {:ok, %{status_code: code}} when code == 429 or code >= 500 ->
          wait_time = :math.pow(2, attempt) * 2 |> round()
          Logger.warning("Tiffy search rate limited/error (#{code}), retrying in #{wait_time}s (attempt #{attempt + 1}/#{@max_retries})")
          Process.sleep(wait_time * 1000)
          call_tiffy_search(query, num_results, search_type, use_deep, attempt + 1)

        {:ok, %{status_code: 200, body: body}} ->
          result = Jason.decode!(body)
          Map.get(result, "results", [])

        {:ok, %{status_code: code}} ->
          Logger.warning("Tiffy search failed: #{code}")
          []

        {:error, %HTTPoison.Error{reason: :timeout}} ->
          Logger.warning("Tiffy search timeout (attempt #{attempt + 1}/#{@max_retries})")
          if attempt < @max_retries - 1 do
            Process.sleep(:math.pow(2, attempt) * 2 |> round() * 1000)
            call_tiffy_search(query, num_results, search_type, use_deep, attempt + 1)
          else
            []
          end

        {:error, reason} ->
          Logger.error("Tiffy search error: #{inspect(reason)}")
          if attempt < @max_retries - 1 do
            Process.sleep(:math.pow(2, attempt) * 2 |> round() * 1000)
            call_tiffy_search(query, num_results, search_type, use_deep, attempt + 1)
          else
            []
          end
      end
    end

    def call_cerebras_chat(messages, max_tokens \\ 65000, temperature \\ 1.0, top_p \\ 0.95, attempt \\ 0) do
      if attempt >= @max_retries, do: ""

      api_key = Config.cerebras_api_key()
      headers = [
        {"Authorization", "Bearer #{api_key}"},
        {"Content-Type", "application/json"}
      ]

      payload = %{

        max_tokens: max_tokens,
        messages: messages,
        temperature: max(0.0, min(2.0, temperature)),
        top_p: max(0.0, min(1.0, top_p))
      }

      case HTTPoison.post("", Jason.encode!(payload), headers, recv_timeout: 60_000) do
        {:ok, %{status_code: 200, body: body}} ->
          result = Jason.decode!(body)
          get_in(result, ["choices", Access.at(0), "message", "content"]) || ""

        {:error, reason} ->
          error_str = to_string(reason) |> String.downcase()
          is_retryable = Enum.any?(["429", "rate limit", "timeout", "500", "502", "503", "504"], &String.contains?(error_str, &1))
          if is_retryable and attempt < @max_retries - 1 do
            wait_time = :math.pow(2, attempt) * 2 |> round()
            Logger.warning("Cerebras chat error, retrying in #{wait_time}s (attempt #{attempt + 1}/#{@max_retries}): #{String.slice(to_string(reason), 0, 100)}")
            Process.sleep(wait_time * 1000)
            call_cerebras_chat(messages, max_tokens, temperature, top_p, attempt + 1)
          else
            Logger.error("Cerebras chat error: #{inspect(reason)}")
            ""
          end
      end
    end

  defmodule Utils do
    def secure_filename(filename) do
      allowed_chars = MapSet.new(String.graphemes("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-_."))
      filename = Path.basename(filename)
      safe_name = filename
      |> String.graphemes()
      |> Enum.filter(&MapSet.member?(allowed_chars, &1))
      |> Enum.join("")

      safe_name = if safe_name == "" or String.starts_with?(safe_name, ".") do
        "file_" <> String.trim_leading(safe_name, ".")
      else
        safe_name
      end

      String.slice(safe_name, 0, 255)
    end

    def escape_html(text) do
      text
      |> to_string()
      |> String.replace("&", "&")
      |> String.replace("<", "<")
      |> String.replace(">", ">")
      |> String.replace("\"", """)
      |> String.replace("'", "'")
    end

    def validate_url(url) do
      url = String.trim(to_string(url))
      if String.starts_with?(url, "http://") or String.starts_with?(url, "https://") do
        escape_html(url)
      else
        ""
      end
    end

    def sanitize_filename(filename) do
      filename
      |> String.replace("..", "")
      |> String.replace("/", "")
      |> String.replace("\\", "")
      |> String.slice(0, 255)
    end

    def validate_file_size(size, max_size \\ 100 * 1024 * 1024) do
      size > 0 and size <= max_size
    end

    def truncate_text(text, max_length \\ 500) do
      text = text || ""
      if String.length(text) > max_length do
        String.slice(text, 0, max_length)
      else
        text
      end
    end

    def generate_simple_embedding(text) do
      if text == nil or text == "" do
        List.duplicate(0.0, 256)
      else
        text = text |> String.downcase() |> String.slice(0, 10000)
        embedding = Enum.map(0..255, fn i ->
          hash = :crypto.hash(:md5, "#{text}_#{i}") |> Base.encode16()
          {val, _} = String.slice(hash, 0, 8) |> Integer.parse(16)
          val / :math.pow(16, 8)
        end)

        norm = :math.sqrt(Enum.reduce(embedding, 0, fn x, acc -> acc + x * x end))
        if norm > 0 do
          Enum.map(embedding, &(&1 / norm))
        else
          embedding
        end
      end
    end

    def extract_confidence_from_response(response) do
      if response == "" or response == nil do
        0.75
      else
        lines = response |> String.trim() |> String.split("\n") |> Enum.take(-10) |> Enum.reverse()

        conf = Enum.find_value(lines, fn line ->
          line_lower = String.downcase(line)
          if String.contains?(line_lower, "bizonyosság") or String.contains?(line_lower, "confidence") or String.contains?(line, "%") do
            numbers = Regex.scan(~r/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/, line) |> List.flatten() |> Enum.take(-1)
            if Enum.any?(numbers) do
              case Float.parse(List.last(numbers)) do
                {conf, _} ->
                  conf = if conf > 1, do: conf / 100.0, else: conf
                  min(1.0, max(0.0, conf))
                :error -> nil
              end
            else
              nil
            end
          else
            nil
          end
        end)

        conf || 0.75
      end
    end
  end

    def compute_consensus(agent_outputs, threshold \\ 0.6) do
      valid_outputs = Enum.filter(agent_outputs, fn ao -> ao.response != "" and ao.response != nil and ao.error == nil end)

      if length(valid_outputs) < 2 do
        %ConsensusResult{
          consensus_reached: length(valid_outputs) == 1,
          consensus_level: if(length(valid_outputs) > 0, do: 1.0, else: 0.0),
          requires_synthesis: length(valid_outputs) == 0
        }
      else
        embeddings = Enum.map(valid_outputs, fn output ->
          if output.embedding != nil do
            output.embedding
          else
            Utils.generate_simple_embedding(output.response)
          end
        end)

        n_clusters = min(3, length(valid_outputs))

        clusters = simple_kmeans(embeddings, n_clusters)

        cluster_map = Enum.zip(valid_outputs, clusters)
        |> Enum.group_by(fn {_output, cluster_id} -> cluster_id end, fn {output, _cluster_id} -> output end)

        cluster_infos = Enum.map(cluster_map, fn {cluster_id, outputs} ->
          avg_confidence = Enum.reduce(outputs, 0.0, fn o, acc -> acc + o.confidence end) / length(outputs)
          cluster_size_weight = length(outputs) / length(valid_outputs)
          weight = avg_confidence * 0.4 + cluster_size_weight * 0.6

          %ClusterInfo{
            cluster_id: cluster_id,
            agent_outputs: outputs,
            centroid_text: Utils.truncate_text(List.first(outputs).response, 500),
            agreement_score: avg_confidence,
            weight: weight
          }
        end)
        |> Enum.sort_by(& &1.weight, :desc)

        winning_cluster = List.first(cluster_infos)
        consensus_level = if winning_cluster, do: winning_cluster.weight, else: 0.0

        outliers = if length(cluster_infos) > 1 do
          Enum.slice(cluster_infos, 1..-1)
          |> Enum.filter(&(&1.weight < 0.2))
          |> Enum.flat_map(& &1.agent_outputs)
        else
          []
        end

        weighted_scores = Map.new(valid_outputs, fn o -> {o.agent_id, o.confidence} end)

        %ConsensusResult{
          consensus_reached: consensus_level >= threshold,
          consensus_level: consensus_level,
          winning_cluster: winning_cluster,
          all_clusters: cluster_infos,
          outliers: outliers,
          weighted_scores: weighted_scores,
          requires_synthesis: consensus_level < threshold or length(cluster_infos) > 2
        }
      end
    end

    defp simple_kmeans(embeddings, k) do
      n = length(embeddings)
      initial_centroids = Enum.take_random(embeddings, k)

      iterate_kmeans(embeddings, initial_centroids, 10)
    end

    defp iterate_kmeans(embeddings, centroids, 0), do: assign_clusters(embeddings, centroids)
    defp iterate_kmeans(embeddings, centroids, iterations) do
      clusters = assign_clusters(embeddings, centroids)
      new_centroids = update_centroids(embeddings, clusters, length(centroids))
      iterate_kmeans(embeddings, new_centroids, iterations - 1)
    end

    defp assign_clusters(embeddings, centroids) do
      Enum.map(embeddings, fn emb ->
        centroids
        |> Enum.with_index()
        |> Enum.min_by(fn {centroid, _idx} -> euclidean_distance(emb, centroid) end)
        |> elem(1)
      end)
    end

    defp update_centroids(embeddings, clusters, k) do
      cluster_groups = Enum.zip(embeddings, clusters)
      |> Enum.group_by(fn {_emb, cluster_id} -> cluster_id end, fn {emb, _cluster_id} -> emb end)

      Enum.map(0..(k-1), fn i ->
        group = Map.get(cluster_groups, i, [List.first(embeddings)])
        avg_embedding(group)
      end)
    end

    defp avg_embedding(embeddings) do
      n = length(embeddings)
      dim = length(List.first(embeddings))

      Enum.map(0..(dim-1), fn i ->
        Enum.reduce(embeddings, 0.0, fn emb, acc -> acc + Enum.at(emb, i) end) / n
      end)
    end

    defp euclidean_distance(v1, v2) do
      Enum.zip(v1, v2)
      |> Enum.reduce(0.0, fn {a, b}, acc -> acc + :math.pow(a - b, 2) end)
      |> :math.sqrt()
    end

      user_message = "Kutatási cél: #{session.goal}\n\nKonszenzus szint: #{Float.round(consensus_result.consensus_level * 100, 1)}%\n\nDomináns klaszter: #{winning_count} szakértő\n\nSzakértői vélemények:\n\n"

      expert_summaries = session.agent_outputs
      |> Enum.with_index(1)
      |> Enum.filter(fn {output, _} -> output.response != "" and output.response != nil and output.error == nil end)
      |> Enum.map(fn {output, i} ->
        "\n--- Szakértő #{i} (#{output.perspective}) ---\nBizonyosság: #{Float.round(output.confidence * 100, 1)}%\n#{Utils.truncate_text(output.response, 1000)}\n"

      |> Enum.join()

      user_message = user_message <> expert_summaries <> "\n\nKérlek készíts egy átfogó szintézist."

      try do

      rescue

  defmodule ResearchEngine do
    def tiffy_create_research_plan(goal) do
      system_prompt = "Te a Tiffy Kutatási Stratéga vagy. Feladatod részletes kutatási terv készítése.\n\nElemezd a kutatási célt és készíts:\n1. 15-25 különböző keresési lekérdezést (queries) - különböző szemszögekből\n2. 8-12 altémát (subtopics) - a téma teljes lefedéséhez\n3. A végső jelentés 10-15 fő szekciójának címeit (report_sections)\n\nVálaszolj CSAK JSON formátumban:\n{\"queries\": [\"query1\", \"query2\", ...], \"subtopics\": [\"topic1\", \"topic2\", ...], \"report_sections\": [\"section1\", \"section2\", ...]}"

      try do
        result = APIClient.call_grok4_api(system_prompt, "Kutatási cél: #{goal}", 5000, 0.7)
        content = result.content

        case Regex.run(~r/\{[^{}]*"queries"[^{}]*\}/s, content) do
          [json_str] ->
            plan_data = Jason.decode!(json_str)
            %ResearchPlan{
              queries: Enum.take(Map.get(plan_data, "queries", [goal]), 25),
              subtopics: Enum.take(Map.get(plan_data, "subtopics", []), 12),
              report_sections: Enum.take(Map.get(plan_data, "report_sections", []), 15),
              target_sources: 1500,
              estimated_pages: 35
            }
          _ ->
            %ResearchPlan{queries: [goal], subtopics: [], report_sections: ["Bevezetés", "Elemzés", "Következtetések"]}
        end
      rescue
        e ->
          Logger.error("Research plan creation error: #{inspect(e)}")
          %ResearchPlan{queries: [goal], subtopics: [], report_sections: ["Bevezetés", "Elemzés", "Következtetések"]}
      end
    end

    def run_iterative_exa_search(session, queries, target_sources \\ 1500) do
      all_sources = []
      seen_urls = MapSet.new()

      {all_sources, _seen_urls} = Enum.reduce_while(Enum.with_index(queries), {all_sources, seen_urls}, fn {query, i}, {sources_acc, seen_acc} ->
        if length(sources_acc) >= target_sources do
          {:halt, {sources_acc, seen_acc}}
        else
          results = APIClient.call_tiffy_search(query, 100, "auto", true)

          {new_sources, new_seen} = Enum.reduce(results, {sources_acc, seen_acc}, fn r, {src_acc, seen_acc} ->
            url = Map.get(r, "url", "")
            if url != "" and not MapSet.member?(seen_acc, url) do
              doc = %SourceDocument{
                url: url,
                title: Map.get(r, "title", ""),
                content: String.slice(Map.get(r, "text", ""), 0, 5000),
                highlights: Enum.take(Map.get(r, "highlights", []), 5),
                published_date: Map.get(r, "publishedDate"),
                relevance_score: Map.get(r, "score", 0.5),
                tokens_estimate: div(String.length(Map.get(r, "text", "")), 4)
              }
              {src_acc ++ [doc], MapSet.put(seen_acc, url)}
            else
              {src_acc, seen_acc}
            end
          end)

          Process.sleep(300)
          {:cont, {new_sources, new_seen}}
        end
      end)

      all_sources
    end

    def tiffy_create_report_outline(session, sections) do
      if Enum.empty?(session.source_documents) do
        Logger.warning("No source documents available for report outline creation")
        []
      else
        source_contents = session.source_documents
        |> Enum.take(100)
        |> Enum.map(fn s -> String.downcase(s.content || "") end)
        |> Enum.join(" ")

        source_titles = session.source_documents
        |> Enum.take(100)
        |> Enum.map(fn s -> String.downcase(s.title || "") end)
        |> Enum.join(" ")

        combined_source_text = source_contents <> " " <> source_titles

        validated_sections = Enum.filter(sections, fn section ->
          section_keywords = String.downcase(section) |> String.split()
          Enum.any?(section_keywords, fn keyword ->
            String.length(keyword) > 3 and String.contains?(combined_source_text, keyword)
          end)
        end)

        validated_sections = if Enum.empty?(validated_sections) do
          Logger.warning("No sections with source coverage found, using top source-based sections")
          top_topics = session.source_documents
          |> Enum.take(30)
          |> Enum.flat_map(fn s ->
            if s.title do
              s.title |> String.split() |> Enum.filter(&(String.length(&1) > 4)) |> Enum.take(3)
            else
              []
            end
          end)
          |> Enum.uniq()
          |> Enum.take(5)

          if Enum.any?(top_topics), do: top_topics, else: ["Összefoglaló elemzés"]
        else
          validated_sections
        end

        system_prompt = "Te a Tiffy Jelentés Tervező vagy. A kutatási eredmények alapján készíts részletes jelentés vázlatot.\n\nKRITIKUS FORRÁSALAPÚ SZABÁLYOK:\n1. KIZÁRÓLAG olyan szekciókat tervezhetsz, amelyekhez a megadott forrásokban VALÓS információ található.\n2. TILOS üres vagy forrás nélküli szekciót létrehozni.\n3. Ha egy javasolt szekcióhoz nincs elegendő forrás, HAGYD KI a vázlatból.\n4. Minden key_point-nak a forrásokban fellelhető információn kell alapulnia.\n5. Ne találj ki témákat vagy alpontokat, amelyekhez nincs adat.\n\nMinden szekcióhoz adj:\n1. section_id: egyedi azonosító\n2. title: szekció címe\n3. target_words: célzott szószám (összesen kb. 80000 szó a teljes jelentéshez = ~500KB)\n4. key_points: 3-5 fő pont amit tartalmaznia kell (CSAK forrásból származó témák!)\n5. sources_to_cite: hány forrást idézzen (5-20)\n6. source_coverage: rövid indoklás, hogy mely források támasztják alá a szekciót\n\nVálaszolj JSON tömb formátumban. Ha egy szekció nem támasztható alá forrásokkal, NE vedd fel a listába."

        sources_summary = "Összesen #{length(session.source_documents)} forrás áll rendelkezésre.\nTop források részletes tartalommal:\n"
        sources_list = session.source_documents
        |> Enum.take(30)
        |> Enum.with_index(1)
        |> Enum.map(fn {s, i} ->
          "[#{i}] #{String.slice(s.title, 0, 100)}: #{String.slice(s.content, 0, 500)}..."
        end)
        |> Enum.join("\n")

        sources_summary = sources_summary <> sources_list

        user_prompt = "Kutatási cél: #{session.goal}\n\nJavasolt szekciók (csak ha van forrás hozzájuk): #{inspect(validated_sections)}\n\n#{sources_summary}"

        try do
          result = APIClient.call_grok4_api(system_prompt, user_prompt, 10_000)
          content = result.content

          case Regex.run(~r/\[[\s\S]*\]/, content) do
            [json_str] ->
              outline = Jason.decode!(json_str)
              Enum.filter(outline, fn item ->
                key_points = Map.get(item, "key_points", [])
                Enum.any?(key_points) and length(key_points) > 0
              end)
            _ ->
              []
          end
        rescue
          e ->
            Logger.error("Report outline error: #{inspect(e)}")
            Enum.with_index(validated_sections)
            |> Enum.map(fn {s, i} ->
              %{
                "section_id" => "sec_#{i}",
                "title" => s,
                "target_words" => 6000,
                "key_points" => ["Elemzés a '#{s}' témában a rendelkezésre álló források alapján"],
                "sources_to_cite" => min(10, length(session.source_documents))
              }
            end)
        end
      end
    end

    def write_report_segment_with_gptoss(session, section, segment_index, previous_summary \\ "") do
      relevant_sources = Enum.take(session.source_documents, 50)

      sources_text = relevant_sources
      |> Enum.take(20)
      |> Enum.with_index(1)
      |> Enum.map(fn {s, i} ->
        "[#{i}] #{s.title}: #{String.slice(s.content, 0, 1000)}"
      end)
      |> Enum.join("\n")

      if Enum.empty?(relevant_sources) or sources_text == "" do
        %ReportSegment{
          segment_id: Map.get(section, "section_id", "seg_#{segment_index}"),
          section_title: Map.get(section, "title", "Szekció #{segment_index}"),
          content: "nincs információ",
          order: segment_index,
          tokens_used: 0,
          sources_cited: []
        }
      else
        key_points_text = Map.get(section, "key_points", ["Részletes elemzés", "Források alapján"]) |> Enum.join("\n")
        previous_text = if previous_summary != "", do: "ELŐZŐ SZEKCIÓ ÖSSZEFOGLALÁSA (folytonosság): #{previous_summary}", else: ""

        prompt = "Írj egy részletes, szakmai szintű kutatási jelentés szekciót az alábbi témáról:\n\nSZEKCIÓ: #{Map.get(section, "title", "Elemzés")}\n\nKUTATÁSI CÉL: #{session.goal}\n\nCÉL SZÓSZÁM: #{Map.get(section, "target_words", 5000)} szó\n\nFŐ PONTOK AMIKET TARTALMAZNIA KELL:\n#{key_points_text}\n\nRENDELKEZÉSRE ÁLLÓ FORRÁSOK:\n#{sources_text}\n\n#{previous_text}\n\nKRITIKUS GROUNDING SZABÁLYOK (KÖTELEZŐ BETARTANI):\n1. KIZÁRÓLAG a fent megadott forrásokból származó információkat használhatod.\n2. TILOS külső információt, saját tudást vagy bármilyen nem forrásolt adatot beleírni.\n3. TILOS kitalált történeteket, fiktív példákat vagy spekulatív tartalmat generálni.\n4. Ha egy témához nincs adat a forrásokban, írd ki: nincs információ\n5. Minden állítást forrásszámmal kell alátámasztani [1], [2], stb.\n6. Ha a források ellentmondanak, jelezd az eltéréseket és ne döntsd el önkényesen.\n7. NE találj ki statisztikákat, dátumokat, neveket vagy egyéb tényszerű adatokat.\n8. Ha a forrás hiányos vagy nem egyértelmű, jelezd ezt explicit módon.\n\nUTASÍTÁSOK:\n- Írj részletes, strukturált elemzést\n- Használj alcímeket és bekezdéseket\n- Hivatkozz a forrásokra számokkal [1], [2], stb.\n- Magyar nyelven írj, szakmai stílusban\n- A szekció legyen önmagában is érthető\n- Minimum #{Map.get(section, "target_words", 5000) - 1000} szó\n- Ha nincs elegendő forrás egy altémához, írd: nincs információ\n\nKezdd a szekció megírását:"

        try do
          response = APIClient.call_cerebras_chat([%{role: "user", content: prompt}], 60_000, 0.8)

          %ReportSegment{
            segment_id: Map.get(section, "section_id", "seg_#{segment_index}"),
            section_title: Map.get(section, "title", "Szekció #{segment_index}"),
            content: response,
            order: segment_index,
            tokens_used: div(String.length(response), 4),
            sources_cited: Enum.take(relevant_sources, Map.get(section, "sources_to_cite", 10)) |> Enum.map(& &1.url)
          }
        rescue
          e ->
            Logger.error("Report segment writing error: #{inspect(e)}")
            %ReportSegment{
              segment_id: "seg_#{segment_index}",
              section_title: Map.get(section, "title", ""),
              content: "Hiba a szekció generálásakor: #{inspect(e)}",
              order: segment_index
            }
        end
      end
    end

    def compile_final_report(session) do
      report_parts = []

      report_parts = report_parts ++ [String.duplicate("=", 80) <> "\n"]
      report_parts = report_parts ++ ["TIFFYTIME PRO KUTATÁSI JELENTÉS\n"]
      report_parts = report_parts ++ [String.duplicate("=", 80) <> "\n\n"]
      report_parts = report_parts ++ ["Kutatási cél: #{session.goal}\n"]
      report_parts = report_parts ++ ["Készült: #{DateTime.utc_now() |> Calendar.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")}\n"]
      report_parts = report_parts ++ ["Feldolgozott források száma: #{session.total_sources_found}\n"]
      report_parts = report_parts ++ [String.duplicate("=", 80) <> "\n\n"]

      report_parts = report_parts ++ ["TARTALOMJEGYZÉK\n"]
      report_parts = report_parts ++ [String.duplicate("-", 40) <> "\n"]

      toc = session.report_segments
      |> Enum.with_index(1)
      |> Enum.map(fn {seg, i} -> "#{i}. #{seg.section_title}\n" end)

      report_parts = report_parts ++ toc
      report_parts = report_parts ++ ["\n" <> String.duplicate("=", 80) <> "\n\n"]

      segments_content = Enum.map(session.report_segments, fn seg ->
        "\n" <> String.duplicate("=", 60) <> "\n" <>
        String.upcase(seg.section_title) <> "\n" <>
        String.duplicate("=", 60) <> "\n\n" <>
        seg.content <> "\n\n"
      end)

      report_parts = report_parts ++ segments_content

      report_parts = report_parts ++ ["\n" <> String.duplicate("=", 80) <> "\n"]
      report_parts = report_parts ++ ["FORRÁSOK\n"]
      report_parts = report_parts ++ [String.duplicate("-", 40) <> "\n"]

      sources_list = session.source_documents
      |> Enum.take(100)
      |> Enum.with_index(1)
      |> Enum.map(fn {doc, i} ->
        "[#{i}] #{doc.title}\n URL: #{doc.url}\n Dátum: #{doc.published_date || "N/A"}\n\n"
      end)

      report_parts = report_parts ++ sources_list

      Enum.join(report_parts, "")
    end

    def run_autonomous_research(session) do
      try do
        session = ResearchSession.update_status(session, TaskStatus.planning(), "Tiffy kutatási terv készítése")
        session = ResearchSession.update_progress(session, 5)

        research_plan = tiffy_create_research_plan(session.goal)
        session = %{session | research_plan: research_plan}

        session = ResearchSession.update_status(session, TaskStatus.exa_searching(), "Tiffy forrás gyűjtés")
        session = ResearchSession.update_progress(session, 15)

        source_documents = run_iterative_exa_search(session, research_plan.queries, research_plan.target_sources)
        session = %{session | source_documents: source_documents, total_sources_found: length(source_documents)}

        session = ResearchSession.update_status(session, TaskStatus.report_planning(), "Jelentés struktúra tervezése")
        session = ResearchSession.update_progress(session, 50)

        report_outline = tiffy_create_report_outline(session, research_plan.report_sections)

        session = ResearchSession.update_status(session, TaskStatus.report_writing(), "Jelentés szekciók írása")

        {session, _prev_summary} = Enum.reduce(Enum.with_index(report_outline), {session, ""}, fn {section, i}, {sess_acc, prev_sum} ->
          progress = 55 + (i / length(report_outline)) * 35
          sess_acc = ResearchSession.update_progress(sess_acc, progress)

          segment = write_report_segment_with_gptoss(sess_acc, section, i, prev_sum)
          sess_acc = %{sess_acc | report_segments: sess_acc.report_segments ++ [segment]}
          new_prev_sum = String.slice(segment.content || "", 0, 500)

          Process.sleep(500)
          {sess_acc, new_prev_sum}
        end)

        session = ResearchSession.update_status(session, TaskStatus.report_compiling(), "Jelentés összeállítása")
        session = ResearchSession.update_progress(session, 92)

        final_report = compile_final_report(session)

        report_filename = "research_report_#{String.slice(session.session_id, 0, 8)}_#{DateTime.utc_now() |> Calendar.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")}.txt"
        report_path = Path.join("uploads", report_filename)
        File.write!(report_path, final_report)

        session = %{session | final_report_path: report_path, final_response: String.slice(final_report, 0, 10_000)}

        session = ResearchSession.update_status(session, TaskStatus.completed(), "Kutatás és jelentés kész")
        session = ResearchSession.update_progress(session, 100)

        try do
          session_data = %{
            "session_id" => session.session_id,
            "user_id" => session.user_id,
            "goal" => session.goal,
            "status" => session.status,
            "progress" => session.progress,
            "created_at" => session.created_at,
            "total_sources_found" => session.total_sources_found,
            "final_report_path" => session.final_report_path,
            "final_response" => session.final_response,
            "total_tokens_used" => session.total_tokens_used
          }

          DragonflyStorage.save_research_session(session.session_id, session_data)
          Logger.info("Research session saved to Dragonfly: #{session.session_id}")
        rescue
          e ->
            Logger.error("Failed to save research to Dragonfly: #{inspect(e)}")
        end

        if SuperMemoryClient.is_available() do
          try do
            summary = String.slice(session.final_response || session.goal, 0, 2000)
            SuperMemoryClient.add_research_memory(
              session.user_id,
              session.session_id,
              session.goal,
              summary,
              session.total_sources_found
            )
            Logger.info("Research saved to SuperMemory: #{session.session_id}")
          rescue
            e ->
              Logger.error("Failed to save research to SuperMemory: #{inspect(e)}")
          end
        end

        session
      rescue
        e ->
          Logger.error("Autonomous research error: #{inspect(e)}")
          session = ResearchSession.update_status(session, TaskStatus.failed(), "Hiba történt")
          %{session | error_message: to_string(e)}
      end
    end
  end

  post "/api/research/start" do
    user_id = get_session(conn, :user_id) || UUID.uuid4()
    body = conn.body_params

    goal = Map.get(body, "goal", "")
    if goal == "" or String.length(goal) < 5 do
      send_json(conn, 400, %{error: "Kutatási cél szükséges (min 5 karakter)"})
    else
      session_id = UUID.uuid4()
      session = ResearchSession.new(%{session_id: session_id, user_id: user_id, goal: goal})

      Task.start(fn ->
        ResearchEngine.run_autonomous_research(session)
      end)

      send_json(conn, 200, %{session_id: session_id, message: "Kutatás elindítva"})
    end
